items.description: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
岛仔 Daozai：Rust 构建的 Windows 桌面信息岛。音乐歌词、邮件验证码、日程提醒、待办与 AI 额度，让重要信息轻轻出现在屏幕顶部。
Lightweight (~1.5 MB) open-source screen annotation with click-through mode and keyboard-first shortcuts. For demos, teaching, meetings & screen recording. Windows, macOS.
小遥搜索，听懂你的话、看懂你的图，用AI找到本地任何文件。让搜索像聊天一样简单。XiaoyaoSearch: Understands your words, reads your images, finds any local file with AI. Making search as easy as chatting.
Atom, Open-Source Governed AI Agent Platform for Self-Hosted Trained Agents For Your Business
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
Microsoft Office Pro 2026 desktop setup with document authoring, spreadsheet engine and presentation assembly bundled into one offline x64 package for Windows 11.

Fuyu (浮屿) — a lightweight dynamic island for Windows & macOS: message alerts from Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, QQ and WeChat, Claude Code / Codex status and approvals with alerts to your phone, clipboard history, translation, lyrics, todos and plugins.
A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows.
Keyboard-first tiling window manager for macOS, inspired by Hyprland

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.

Open-source Arc-style browser built on Chromium: sidebar with vertical tabs, Spaces, folders, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click import from Arc. macOS and Windows (Linux is coming soon). No telemetry.
Free, open-source Mac utility: start dragging any file, tap a key, and drop it on a wheel to convert, edit, AirDrop or shelve it. Runs fully offline.
The control plane for your AI employees

Free, open-source menu bar toolkit for macOS. Eighteen tools in one panel: Pomodoro timer, time tracker, keep-awake, system monitor, clipboard history, file converter, window manager, torrents, archives, OCR, screenshots, draw on screen, color picker, VPN switcher, app launcher, uninstaller, keyboard lock, speed test. SwiftUI, no telemetry, MIT.
